scientific_summary: Perceptual autoencoding learns a spatial latent space separately from generative diffusion. A time-conditional U-Net denoises in that lower-dimensional space; cross-attention supplies conditional control; decoding is one pass.
invariants: Compression is learned before diffusion; latent space is fixed during generative learning.
Condition encoder and denoiser are jointly optimized; do not mark the condition encoder frozen.
Forward noising is fixed and training-only; synthesis begins from Gaussian latent noise.
Keep actual latent spatial grids, not a one-dimensional token vector.
A shared decoder reconstructs encoded inputs and decodes generated latent samples in one pass.
Schematic landscape miniatures are illustrative, not measured samples.
Q derives from U-Net spatial features; K,V derive from encoded condition. No full attention formula needed.
layout: Title Latent Diffusion. One complete 1700×1000 rectangular overview organized by six equal-width columns and two equal-height aligned scientific lanes, with a shallow middle conditioning strip. Top: Perceptual Compression. Bottom: Latent Generation. Upper and lower image thumbnails share left/right edges, labels share baselines, pale lane backgrounds share the exact left and right bounds. The shared decoder occupies one vertical column with separate aligned reconstruction and generation ports. The wider innovative denoising group spans two integer columns. These are invisible placement bounds, not a grid of empty cards. Preserve all scientific miniature views. Do not add phase labels from any other workflow.
